license_scope: The redistributed checkpoint and accompanying software notices are preserved. The underlying Materials Project training corpus is not redistributed and is not relicensed by this package.
training_disclosure: Pretrained on Materials Project GGA/GGA+U trajectories (about 1.5 million structures from 146,000 compounds), including energy, force, stress and magnetic-moment targets. Energy targets already include MP2020 corrections. Training may overlap chemical systems or the auxiliary MP table; this package does not claim contamination-free or wholly unseen-composition evaluation.
